headline: Expanse Fire Rises; Marban Swings to Colonials; Nevish Line Pressed
war_summary: At Weathered Expanse the grinding continues unabated. Fifty-two actions were logged in the past day, nine of them within two hours and the latest at 05:55, at a cost of 7,189 Colonial and 8,104 Warden casualties; the works there now read three Warden, four Colonial and two unclaimed. Kuura Strand runs quieter — two actions in the past two hours against thirty-two for the day — its lines standing at one Warden work and five Colonial. The Nevish Line stays the busier front, eight actions in two hours about Princefal and Tomb Father, leaving four Warden, two Colonial and two unclaimed. Marban Hollow has swung markedly, now six Colonial works to one Warden with one unclaimed, Checkpoint Bua accounting for twenty-three actions. Linn Mercy continues to bleed, 182 Warden and 83 Colonial casualties in the last hour alone, Lathair busiest, though its works have largely held. Stlican Shelf has cooled to two actions in six hours. Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands remain costly but without fresh flips.
